Fixed in /app/backend/tests/test_track_19_00_transportation_driver_carrier_foundation.py by making fixture generate a timestamp-suffixed legal_name + DOT. Production code path is correct.

rca of the issue: Pre-existing pytest fixture failure (2/22) was a test-isolation defect, not a production defect. The carrier-create endpoint correctly rejects duplicate active carrier legal_names with 409 (this is the intended uniqueness guard, validated in code). The fixture supplied a static legal_name from a prior run, hence 409 on re-execution. Mitigation: legal_name suffixed with int(time.time()*1000) and DOT suffixed with a time-derived number — guarantees idempotent test reruns without weakening the production uniqueness invariant. No backend code modified.
